en: Who dares enter MY forest? Crush them!
I followed the black candles too. Seraphine, paladin of the dawn. If the dark is moving north, so am I.
The Goblin King falls, but he was only taking orders. A trail of black candles leads north, to the old crypt.
Stay behind me. Whatever comes out of those trees, we face it together.
Do wolves like fire? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.
Wolf tracks. Fresh ones, and a lot of them. Stay sharp.
Among the goblin loot: a healer's satchel and a letter from the mountain abbey, begging for help on the road.
Wolves and goblins working together? Someone is training them.
You must be the ones clearing the road. I am Maren. Judging by those bruises, you need me.
Vex. I hear the goblin king wears a gold crown. Help me get it and I will split it with you. Mostly.
Their warband gathers at the gate. Whatever we find inside, we hold the line.
Goblins have been raiding the Greenwood road. Three young heroes set out to stop them.
The living always come to me in the end. You are merely early.
With its last breath the Lich laughs: the army was never his. It belongs to the dragon of the Peak.
I read about this place. Mostly the part that said 'never go in'.
These bones were laid to rest. Someone woke them. That is a cruelty I will not forgive.
Kael. I tracked the cultists here. Smells wrong down below. Even the rats left.
Candle Hall. Lots of candles. Lots of candlesticks. Silver ones.
These cultists are not raising the dead for fun. They are building an army.
You there, heroes. The Lich stole my storm-glass. Help me take it back and I will lend you the sky.
It is not just you. Stay close to the light, Pip.
Is it just me, or is it getting colder?
Beneath the hills lies the Crypt of Ash, sealed for a hundred years. The seal is broken.
Little heroes. I have burned kingdoms. I will not even remember your names.
Rest now, old friend. The sky is yours again.
The Red Dragon falls and the sky clears. The road home is long, but it is finally safe.
Orcs, wyverns, and a dragon at the top. Nobody said this would be easy.
Wyverns nest on these cliffs. Keep your heads low and your shields high.
Orcs! Splendid. My ballad desperately needed a villainous chorus. Fennick, at your service!
Fire against storm. Let us see who the sky truly favors.
The priests are feeding the dragon's fire. Stop them and the beast weakens.
I know this bridge. I crossed it on dragonback, long ago. She was not cruel then.
Whatever waits at the top, we face it together. Just like the first day on the road.
Dragon's Peak burns on the horizon. Orc warbands march under a crimson banner.
Lyra's mother, lost in the Hollow ten years ago. Found.
She has stitched more wounds than any surgeon, and prays while she sews.
She lights a candle for every soul the abbey lost. Each one burns.
A monk who took a vow of silence and a vow of violence.
He leads a choir of ghosts. Two of them are still alive.
A dwarf smith with an anvil for a shield. He insists it is a shield.
An eager apprentice whose spells sometimes work exactly as planned.
A keen-eyed archer who never misses twice.
A village watchman who walked out of the Ashfall carrying three children and a door for a shield.
A Warden's grandson who took his grandfather's oath and shield.
A bard whose songs make cowards brave.
A Wildwarden who let the Elder Tree grow into his skin.
He keeps the abbey graves. Lately he has to keep them closed.
Owns the only firearm in the world. It explodes about half the time.
Builds repeating crossbows and tests them personally.
Sworn to die at the Throne. She intends to be late.
Last commander of the Order of the Bulwark. The Order is her and four recruits.
Raised by bears, ruined by the blight, saved by rage.
He studied the drowned library until the ink began to read him.
The drowned chapel's last priest. He still rings the bell below the waves.
She survived the dragon's last breath. Now the ash answers when she calls.
A healer from the mountain abbey.
A knight in a steam-driven suit. Nobody has seen inside it for years.
Half her armor is coral that grew over her while she slept beneath the waves.
Ilvane's sister. She came to the Throne to finish what her sister started, or undo it.
A Black Tide deserter. He plundered the drowned city, then saw what still lived in it.
The last rider of the red dragons.
He died on the sea wall. The tide sent him back, and he does not know why.
He leads caravans across the glass and has buried more travelers than he has delivered.
A shepherd whose flute calms beasts and, lately, the blighted.
A forge-golem with a dwarf's heart sealed in its chest. The dwarf volunteered.
A fey archer whose arrows arrive slightly before they are loosed.
She dances on hot glass barefoot. The glass gives up first.
An assassin of the Sand Courts who tips her blades with scorpion venom.
She spins storm-glass, the stuff the fourth Seal was made of.
A cliff-runner who reads storms in the flight of gulls.
The jarl who demanded the blood-oaths. He paid his own first.
A field surgeon who has taken off forty legs and saved forty lives.
A blind sand-seer who sees the Hollow coming in every grain.
She wields a hammer forged from the Last Ember's scraps.
She hunts things the size of churches with a rope and a prayer.
Her hawks have eaten the eyes of three blight-lords.
A gravedigger who dreamed of the Hollow Gate and has not slept since.
His mother was a frost giant. He is the small one.
A tracker raised by the forest itself.
Shield-maiden of the north wall. Never retreated; once advanced by accident.
The runesmith of Ironhold who reforged the Last Ember.
Shield-sister of the forge-guard. She braids iron wire into her hair for luck.
A skald who fights with an axe and sings the deaths he causes.
A forge-priestess who blesses weapons by hitting them.
A steadfast knight sworn to guard the Greenwood road.
Keeper of the last lighthouse on the coast. Her lamp burns for the dead now.
Corvin's apprentice. She writes down every oath of the Hundred, in her own blood.
He can hit a coin across the dunes at noon. He charges extra for the coin.
Fletches arrows from blighted wood. They spread what they carry.
She burned witches for the Church. Now she hunts the vampires who corrupted it.
She speaks with the moss, and the moss tells her where enemies will step.
Ilvane's apprentice. The Hollow took her left hand; she uses the hole.
A blight-witch who turned on her coven when they fed children to the Rot Stag.
He watched the abbey walls for twenty years. The one night he slept, it fell.
She cut a hole in the Hollow with her sword. Something cut back.
She steals seconds from her enemies and gives them to her friends.
A paladin whose shield has never broken.
The last Archmage, now that Ilvane is gone. He did not want the job.
A djinn bound to a sword by Ilvane. Freed by the party, he serves by choice.
She spears eels in black water by the glow of their own hunger.
He hunts Hollow-spawn for bounty. The bounty-payers are all dead.
Stands at the edge of the Rift every night and pushes things back in.
Her sword is cold enough to stop a heart. She has checked.
A rogue who fights for coin and
Carves runes into shields. Some are prayers, some are threats.
The oldest Wildwarden. She remembers when the Elder Tree was a seed.
A Warden's armor walking without a Warden. It answers to the Hundred.
A son of House Vey who turned blood magic against his mother.
Her arrows are melted-down abbey candlesticks. Vex is jealous.
A siren who cut out her own song so it could never lure sailors again. She sings with her hands.
A tunnel scavenger who knows every crack in Ironhold, and every pocket.
White furs, white bow, white breath. You hear the arrow, then nothing.
Glowing spores drift from her sleeves. Where they land, wounds close or flesh rots.
Rides the last white stag. The Rot Stag was its brother.
He hunts House Vey with silver and spite.
Counts the stars every night. Lately there are fewer.
She speaks and the sky answers.
She carries the last lantern from the abbey into the dark.
Once Malrec's bodyguard. He knows every trick his master taught him, and hates them all.
He kept the Arcanum's library through the betrayal and will not forgive Ilvane.
The Weeping Saint's last acolyte. She still hears the Saint cry.
A fey-court duelist exiled for winning a duel she was meant to lose.
The harbor-master who held the sea wall alone the night Ys-Marrow drowned.
A sea-witch who bargained with the Tide Mother and lost something she will not name.
Lays traps for wendigo. He has caught three, and a jarl.
A clan berserker who swore a blood-oath to the party. The clan wants it back.
A seeress who speaks to the frozen Titan. It speaks back, slowly.
She fires arrows of starlight. The stars are running out.
A glass golem of the Arcanum whose maker is long dead. It still guards the door.
A healer who learned to cure the Hollow-touched by taking the Hollow into herself.
She runs with a wolf pack the clans pretend not to see.
She keeps the last oasis. Every traveler drinks, even enemies, once.
She keeps the hearth fire of the clans alive, feeds anyone and scolds everyone.
A knight of House Vey who refused the blood. They took her family instead.
